//: The portal only. The API runs on Render — see render.yaml — and this site
is told where to find it by VITE_API_URL at build time.
The API is deliberately not deployed here. `api/index.mjs` exists so the
whole thing *can* run on Vercel instead, and .vercelignore keeps Vercel
from picking it up in this arrangement: two APIs answering the same
portal, one of them without a database, is worse than either alone.
Because the two halves are on different hosts, the API must name this
site in CORS_ORIGINS and send its session cookie cross-site
This repository is an npm workspace, so the build runs the web workspace
and writes web/dist rather than the `public` Vercel looks for by default.

rewrites.//: The portal resolves its own routes: /admin/students is not a file on disk, so anything that is not a real file returns index.html. /api and /uploads belong to the API on Render — answering them with this site's HTML would turn a clear failure into a baffling one, the portal reading a web page where it expected data.
